title: Comparison of module cup classes with derived global sections
statement: For every scheme X, assume HasDerivedCategory for sheaves of O_X-modules. There is a family of Gamma(X,O_X)-linear equivalences from H^n(X,F), defined as the right-derived global sections functor, to degree-n homology of RΓ(F[0]), for every module sheaf F and every natural n. For every computing resolution D of F [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data] and global cocycle a in degree n, the integer extension of Γ(D.K) contains a cycle z whose component, under the extension identification, is the underlying section of a. The equivalence sends D.class n a to the image of the localized homology class of z [new-module-cup-derived-homology-tensor] under the canonical right-derived comparison unit followed by RΓ of the inverse localized augmentation [def-sc-module-cup-realization-complex-data]. The units are moduleCup_globalComparison and moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans, as defined in [lem-sc-module-cup-naive-derived-compatibility] and [lem-sc-module-cup-kinjective-target].

source.place: cohomology computed by injective resolutions; Tag 0FKU for derived comparison

proof.text: Install enough injectives for module sheaves. For each coefficient F, use the actual Mathlib injectiveResolution F. Its extension to integer degrees is bounded below and consists of injectives, so CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective proves it K-injective. The right-derived unit on it is an isomorphism by the existing RightDerivedFunctor.Defs instance; The component (moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans X).app K transports that unit through quotientCompQhIso. This is definitionally moduleCup_globalComparison X K, but using the component directly avoids importing the naive/derived compatibility module and its conflicting generated local instances. Compose InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj, the inverse extension/mapExtend homology isomorphism, the inverse homologyFunctorFactors isomorphism, and homology of the comparison followed by the inverse localized augmentation. Each factor is an actual isomorphism, giving injectiveClassIso and its linear equivalence.

Extend the comparison D.K to D.I, followed by InjectiveResolution.homotopyEquiv D.I J, to integer degrees. D.over and homotopyEquiv_hom_ι give augmentation_comparison. Naturality of moduleCup_comparisonNatTrans and cancellation of the invertible augmentation give global_transport. Mathlib isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality identifies the natural-degree homology transport; naturality of mapExtendIso and extendHomologyIso identifies its integer-degree version. Naturality of homologyFunctorFactors gives injectiveClassIso_transport. These are proved local lemmas and do not use the product resolution-invariance theorem.

Convert a from the explicit kernel presentation to L.cycles n by moduleCatCyclesIso.inv. Define z by applying sectionCyclesIso.inv. The hom_inv identity, cyclesMap_i and extendCyclesIso_hom_iCycles prove its component equation. The naturality equation for homologyπ and homologyπ_extendHomologyIso_hom gives sectionCyclesIso_homologyπ. Evaluate injectiveClassIso_transport on K.homologyπ n z and substitute this equation; unfolding D.class, cupCycleClass and cupLocalizedCycleClass gives the required class formula. No new unproved lemma or choice of unspecified data is used. The same equations apply at n=0 and for zero cycles.
